title: BotNexus plugin manifest
description: On-disk contract for .botnexus-plugin/plugin.json. This file is the single source of truth for plugin manifest field names and requiredness; the C# parser loads it rather than duplicating the field list in code.

name.description: Unique plugin identifier. Lowercase kebab-case so it is safe in paths, URLs and config keys.

description.description: Human readable summary shown in marketplace listings.

version.description: Semantic version of the plugin release.

skills.description: Explicit skill paths. Omit to rely on convention-based discovery at the plugin root.

agents.description: Explicit agent definition paths. Omit to rely on convention-based discovery.

commands.description: Explicit command paths. Omit to rely on convention-based discovery.

hooks.description: Explicit hooks configuration path. Omit to rely on convention-based discovery.

mcpServers.description: Explicit MCP server configuration path. Omit to rely on convention-based discovery.

extension.description: A prebuilt gateway extension carried by this plugin. Plugins are copied verbatim with no build step, so the referenced assembly and assets must already be built and committed to the plugin repository. Omit for a skills-only plugin.

manifest.description: Plugin-relative path to the carried extension's botnexus-extension.json. Must resolve inside the plugin directory.
